explanation: Friends nicknamed him Dr. Bug. He pictured creatures crawling along the Game Boy's link cable from one player to another, which became the trading at the heart of the games.

claims.text: Satoshi Tajiri has said that his childhood hobby of collecting insects inspired Pokémon.
Stamp collecting, keeping tropical fish and breeding pigeons are not the hobbies Tajiri credited for Pokémon.
As a boy, Tajiri was nicknamed 'Dr. Bug'.
Tajiri imagined creatures travelling along the Game Boy link cable between players, an image behind trading in Pokémon.
